title: CLAUDE.md
text: compute-intensive work C++ Rcpp bindings: netcdf_io.cpp/h — Direct NetCDF-C /O spatial/temporal subsetting, CF time parsing, scale_factor/add_offset/_FillValue handling. Supports NC_CHAR NC_STRING attributes. Reorders data pixel-major layout [pixel][time] cache-friendly per-pixel processing. Reads writes climatology, event, SST NetCDF files. climatology.cpp/h — Full ts2clm algorithm: gap filling, NA interpolation, DOY assignment (non-leap years skip DOY 60), spread DOY×year matrix, sliding-window percentile (Type-7 quantile matching R exactly), circular-padded rolling mean smoothing. OpenMP parallelism pixels progress reporting. event_detect.cpp/h — Full detect_event algorithm: threshold exceedance, run-length encoding, duration filtering, gap joining, 19 event metric computations. Cold spell support (threshold inversion). Optional inline Hobday et al. (2018) category computation (Moderate IV Extreme) season assignment. OpenMP parallelism pixels progress reporting. blob_label.cpp — 3D connected-component labeling (union-find, 6-connectivity, optional dateline wrap). Ported heatwaveR. blob_metrics.cpp — Per-(blob, day) spatial metric reduction. Ported heatwaveR. heatwave3_init.cpp — Rcpp exports bridging C++ R. Key exports: hw3_compute_clim, hw3_detect_events (category/hemisphere params), hw3_read_sst, hw3_read_event_nc, hw3_read_clim_nc, hw3_category, hw3_block_average, hw3_read_metric_summary. heatwave3_types.h — Core structs: EventResult (19 metrics + category + season), EventData (reading event NetCDF), SubsetSpec, ClimData, GridData.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Function names suffixed 3 avoid conflicts heatwaveR: detect3() — Primary entry point. --one: climatology + detection + optional inline categories. Supports return_df = TRUE interactive use. ts2clm3() — NetCDF → climatology NetCDF (seas + thresh per DOY per pixel) detect_event3() — SST + climatology → event NetCDF. Supports category = TRUE inline categorisation hemisphere = "south"/"north" season naming. return_df = TRUE returns data.frame directly. category3() — Reads pre-computed categories event file, computes climatology file older events. hemisphere parameter replaces deprecated S. block_average3() — Yearly event metric aggregation (pure C++) exceedance3() — Static threshold exceedance detect_blob3() — 3D spatially-connected blob detection event_line3() — Per-pixel time series plot NetCDF (C++ reader, ncdf4) geom_flame3() / geom_lolli3() — ggplot2 custom geoms plot_metric3() — Spatial map event metrics (C++-backed aggregation via hw3_read_metric_summary)

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Pixel-major memory layout: SST data reordered [pixel][time] contiguous per-pixel time series access OpenMP parallel loops. Type-7 quantile: Matches R’s default quantile() exactly via linear interpolation. CF ragged array: Event NetCDF uses event dimension lon/lat coordinate variables — avoids wasteful padding max_events. R NetCDF dependency runtime: Uses libnetcdf C API directly via configure script. four functions previously used ncdf4 (category3, block_average3, plot_metric3, event_line3) now use C++ reader. Inline categories: Category computation uses climatology data already loaded detection — zero extra /O.

title: Performance benchmark: heatwave3 vs heatwaveR
text: Benchmarked Apple M3 Pro (12-core), macOS 15.5, R 4.5.3. speedup comes three sources: C++ algorithms. Climatology (sliding-window percentile) event detection (run-length encoding, gap joining, 19 metrics) implemented pure C++ rather R + data.table. OpenMP parallelism. pixel independent, OpenMP distributes pixels across cores zero coordination overhead. Direct NetCDF /O. Reads full data slab one C call via libnetcdf, avoiding R’s per-pixel ncdf4 random-access overhead.

title: Compute climatology for gridded NetCDF data — ts2clm3
text: file_in Path single multi-timestep NetCDF file, character vector daily NetCDF file paths, directory path containing daily NetCDF files (matched .nc .nc4 extension). file_out Path output NetCDF file containing climatology. climatologyPeriod character vector length 2 specifying start end dates baseline period, example c("1982-01-01", "2011-12-31"). lon_range Optional numeric vector length 2: c(min_lon, max_lon). NULL, longitudes used. lat_range Optional numeric vector length 2: c(min_lat, max_lat). NULL, latitudes used. time_range Optional character vector length 2: c("start", "end"). NULL, time steps read. depth Optional integer depth/level index 4D data. Default NULL (depth subsetting). var_name Name SST variable NetCDF file. NULL, variable auto-detected. maxPadLength Maximum number consecutive missing days interpolate. Default FALSE (interpolation). Set integer enable. windowHalfWidth Half-width sliding window climatology calculation. Default 5 (11-day window). pctile Percentile threshold climatology. Default 90. smoothPercentile Logical. Apply rolling mean smoothing climatology? Default TRUE. smoothPercentileWidth Width rolling mean window smoothing. Default 31. var Logical. Compute variance climatology? Default FALSE. detrend Logical. Remove linear trend pixel's time series computing climatology? Default FALSE (fixed-baseline, Hobday et al. 2016). Set TRUE apply detrended-baseline approach (Jacox et al. 2020). roundClm Number decimal places rounding. Default 4. Set FALSE disable. save_file Optional path additional output file. extension determines format must one .csv, .rds, .parquet. NULL, companion file written. return_df Logical. TRUE, return climatology long data.frame addition writing NetCDF file. Default FALSE (returns file path invisibly). n_threads Number OpenMP threads parallel computation. Default 1. skip_bad_files Logical. multi-file inputs, skip unreadable files files mismatched grids instead failing. Default FALSE.

title: heatwave3 1.1.3 (2026-06-02)
text: OpenMP now works macOS. Multithreading silently disabled (package ran single-threaded regardless n_threads) three faults configure OpenMP probe: run-test checked input vector instead .C() return value always “failed”; undefined SHLIB_CXX17FLAGS spliced ERROR: string compile flags; probe match package’s scheduling. parallel loops now use schedule(static, 1) rather schedule(dynamic) (round-robin load balance, needing symbols present every libomp; schedule(dynamic) requires __kmpc_dispatch_deinit, R’s bundled libomp lacks, caused dlopen failures symbol found ... ___kmpc_dispatch_deinit). macOS build now links R’s libomp, whole R process shares single OpenMP runtime instead dragging second, conflicting copy. new vignette, Parallel performance, documents OpenMP versus R-side (parallel) scaling per-platform setup. detect_event3(return_df = TRUE) now matches saved event CSV output. returned data frame now includes full event-variable set written event NetCDF companion CSV, including pixel_index, threshold-relative intensity metrics, absolute intensity metrics. Category season labels returned character values CSV reads return_df output compare cleanly. detect3() now passes current base-function options. Companion output paths can supplied separately climatology event outputs, detrend passed ts2clm3(). detect3() now passes secondary event-detection options. threshClim2, threshClim2_var_name, minDuration2, maxGap2 passed detect_event3(). NetCDF time calendars temperature units handled defensibly. Non-Gregorian CF calendars now fail explicit error instead silently interpreted Gregorian, climatology/event NetCDF outputs now preserve input temperature units instead hard-coding degC. Multi-file input handling fail-fast default. Unreadable files mismatched grids now stop multi-file reads unless skip_bad_files = TRUE supplied explicitly. Event categories now use unrounded peak intensity internally. Category labels progress values still written requested rounding, category boundaries longer affected rounded intensity_max values. category3() now documented validated convenience wrapper. Inline categories detect_event3(category = TRUE) can read without climatology file; uncategorised event files now require clim_file clear error. detect_blob3() now validates fragile arguments. Unsupported connectivity, invalid return components, invalid ranking variables, singleton grids, grid mismatches now fail explicit errors.

title: heatwave3 1.1.2 (2026-06-02)
text: detect_event3() longer glues events across calendar gaps input SST stack. input missing days (e.g. unavailable OSTIA files), run-length-encoding detect_pixel_events() walked array indices rather calendar dates. event -threshold days sides missing-data window joined one event whose reported date_end − date_start + 1 larger duration (calendar-span > index-count). fix expands per-pixel series dense daily array front (mirroring ts2clm3() always done compute_pixel_clim), filling missing dates NA. proto_event() breaks runs gap exactly heatwaveR::detect_event() via make_whole(). Verified pixel--pixel agreement heatwaveR (1705 / 1705 events Cape Town OSTIA region match exactly: count, date_start / peak / end, duration, intensities rounding precision) synthetic 30-day-gap reproducer. Internal API change: EventResult gains three integer fields (jd_start, jd_peak, jd_end) holding absolute Julian Day start, peak, end event. index_* fields now indices dense (gap-filled) array rather sparse input. Downstream code uses hw3_read_event_nc() / category3() / block_average3() unaffected: NetCDF event-file layout R-facing return values unchanged.

title: heatwave3 1.1.1 (2026-05-28)
text: ts2clm3() now validates parent directory file_out exists running climatology computation. Previously, invalid path (e.g. typo dev/test/clim.nc dev/tests/ exists) caused libnetcdf fail write step misleading Permission denied, full per-pixel climatology already computed. new check fires immediately clear Output directory exist: ... message. hw3_export() now correctly handles climatology files whose grid singleton longitude latitude dimension. Previously ncdf4::ncvar_get() dropped singleton dimension default, causing seas[, j, ] fail incorrect number dimensions. variable now read collapse_degen = FALSE. hw3_export() now writes Hobday et al. (2018) category season values human-readable labels ("Moderate", "II Strong", …, "Summer", "Fall", …) exporting event file, matching labels returned category3(). Previously raw integer codes (1–4) written, making exported CSV / RDA / Parquet hard use directly.
